items.label: diagnosis
items.evidence: you need paper-qa version 5. The `settings` module didn't exist before then in versions such as version 4.
items.rationale: Gives the root cause (the user has an old version) and the suggested `pip install paper-qa>=5` matches the README change. It doesn't name the file to edit.
